Commentary.Commentary: West Indies displayed yet another ordinary performance with the ball. The youngster, Alzarri Joseph, proved to be their best bowler, conistently bowling good lines and ended up picking 2 wickets. The other successful bowlers in terms of wickets were Jason Holder and Sunil Narine, who bagged 2 and 1 respectively, with the latter proving to be economical once again. The Pakistani batsmen have done their job by putting runs on the board. Now, it's up to their bowlers to do their job. The West Indian batters have come up with no answers to the Pak bowlers, will they do it this time? It remains to be seen. Stay tuned for the chase.

Pakistan have once again been the commander in this innings. They started off in a hurry, trying to score quick runs but were brought to a halt after both the openers were sent back at the 40-run mark. Still that didn't even troubled Pakistan a bit as Babar Azam and Shoaib Malik stabled the ship and then cruised through. The latter took the charge by attacking the West Indies bowlers, especially the spinners and went on to make 90 off 84 balls. Whereas, the latter completed back-to-back centuries, playing a sensible knock. In the end, it was their T20I skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed who made 60 in a flash and remained unbeaten to end the Pakistani innings on 337.

Bumper from Joseph, Sarfraz doesn't control the pull as well as he'd like and gets it off the toe end of the bat. Ends up hitting it down to fine leg and takes a single. And with that, PAKISTAN FINISH THEIR INNINGS ON 337/5!

FOUR! EDGED AND AWAY! When it's going for you, it's going for you, isn't it? Length ball outside off, Sarfraz just flashes his bat at this. Gets a thick, thick outside edge which flies down towards the third man boundary.

FOUR! BANG! Back of a length delivery around off, Sarfraz Ahmed picks up the length early and pulls this hard over mid-wicket. Sends it one bounce across the ropes for a boundary. Really latched onto that and middled it beautifully.
A bouncer from Alzarri Joseph, gets big on Rizwan who gets it off the edge as he looks to pull. A single taken.
Off-cutter from Joseph, comes on a little slower than Rizwan expected but he managed to hit this towards deep square leg anyway. Runs hard and gets a double for it.
Arrowed in full and coming in on middle and leg, it's flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
6th ODI fifty for Sarfraz Ahmed!
Length ball outside off, it's played to point for a single. He brings up his half century with that and that's his fastest ever in this format.
Length ball outside off, it's cut away late past backward point towards third man for a single.
Full and on the stumps, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
MOHAMMAD RIZWAN is in next to bat.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! He went for the big one and he missed it. The lack of pace on it probably surprised him. Length ball angling in on off, Imad Wasim goes for the big slog over mid-wicket. He misses the ball compeletely and has his off stump knocked over. Not much to do other than that at this stage of the game, anyway. Another wicket down for Pakistan.
Comes from around the wicket and fires in a full ball way outside off, Imad Wasim looks to go after it but misses.
Full and on the stumps, it's off the inside half and the ball rolls over to mid-wicket. Single taken.
JASON HOLDER to bowl the penultimate over of the match!
Fuller length ball on middle and leg, it goes off the inside half as Ahmed looks to flick. Goes down to fine leg as the batsmen cross over.
Wide! Make that two in a row. This just adds to the frustration. Back of a length and angling down as Sarfraz is looking to pull it away. Misses as another wide is called.
Wide! This is going down leg once more. Another wide.
Shortish in length and on middle and leg, it's pulled behind square on the leg side for one more.
FOUR! SHOT! Poor ball and that's rightly put away. High full toss around off, Imad Wasim stands this ground and with all his might, pulls this high over the mid-wicket region to send it all the way.
Some extra bounce for Joseph, makes things difficult for Sarfraz as he mistimes the pull to short fine leg. A run is added to the total.
Wide! A full toss which goes way down the leg side, it's signalled as a wide by the umpire. A loud groan of frustration from Alzarri Joseph.
Banged in short, around off, Imad Wasim couldn't middle the pull as he gets this off the splice towards mid-wicket. Can only take a single in the end.
Low full on middle and off, Imad Wasim hits this back down the ground and gets two runs for it.
FOUR! HAT-TRICK OF BOUNDARIES! Length delivery outside off, Ahmed waits for it and then cuts sharply through the gap at backward point for yet another boundary. 19 RUNS OFF THE OVER!

FOUR! TWO IN TWO! Short delivery with not much pace on it. Ahmed is onto it in a flash, he pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Pollard is walking into Sarfraz's hand by bowling at this pace. 300 up for Pakistan!
FOUR! Length delivery angling in from off, Ahmed pulls it over square leg for a boundary. Narine in the deep tries to save it with his boot but instead kicks it into the boundary.
Sarfraz dances down, Pollard sees that and takes the pace off the ball and pitches it shorter. Sarfraz flat-bats it down to long on for a couple.
FOUR! HIT HARD! Full on middle and leg, Ahmed slogs it hard over widish mid on for a boundary. The ball reached the fence in a flash.
Full and wide outside off, Wasim drives it uppishly over mid off. The ball goes one bounce into the hands of Bravo. The batsmen run through for a single.
Very, very full outside off, Imad Wasim drills it to mid off and takes off to complete the run.
Short ball banged in on middle and off, it's pulled to deep square leg with ease as a single is taken.

Fractionally fuller in length and pitched just outside off, Sarfraz walks across and tucks it behind square on the leg side. Some good, hard running between the wickets allow the batsmen to come back for the second.

Sarfraz once again looking a little rusty here. Joseph takes the pace off it once more and bowls it short. The slowness of the pitch doesn't help and it doesn't allow Sarfraz to connect his ramp shot.
Back of a length and angling across, Imad Wasim slaps this back down the ground towards mid off for a single.
IMAD WASIM walks in next!

OUT! BABAR AZAM DEPARTS! A great knock has finally come to an end. He can keep his head held high as he's played very well here. Full and on the stumps, Joseph takes the pace off it and Babar Azam doesn't pick it up. He slogs this hard but doesn't get all of it as he's a bit early into the shot. It's down the throat of Carlos Brathwaite who does well at long on. He runs to his right and settles himself under it well to gobble it up. Babar Azam makes his way back to a standig ovation from his dressing room.
ALZARRI JOSEPH is brought back into the attack!
Slower one once more, it's turned to deep square leg. Some good running allows the batsmen to come back for the second. Good running between the wickets.
Fullish in length once more and around off, Babar Azam walks forward and across to swipe it across the line to deep mid-wicket. One run added to the scoreboard.
Sarfraz comes forward to this fuller ball and hits it down to long off. One run taken.
Slower one from Pollard here, the lack of pace does Sarfraz in as he's into the pull too early. Misses and he won't get any run for it.
Pitched slightly ahead of a length, it's half-driven, half-punched down to long on for one run.
Full length delivery outside off, Babar Azam gives it a full swing of the bat and drives it hard through the covers for a couple of good runs.
Full and attacking the stumps here, Babar Azam flicks this through mid-wicket.
Fullish and pitched outside off, it's pushed to the cover region for a brisk single.
FOUR! SMASHED! Full outside off, Babar Azam just lifts this over covers for a boundary. He seems to be having fun out there, just toying with the West Indies bowlers.

NOT OUT! That was actually a pretty close one, can't fault the Windies for taking the review for that. Brathwaite spears in a yorker on leg, sliding down, Sarfraz gets down to this one and looks to paddle it away. He is caught on the back leg as he misses and there's a huge appeal for a leg before. The batsmen take a leg bye during this but the umpire is unmoved. Brathwaite and Ramdin are convinced the batsman is gone and so decide to take the review. It goes upstairs and replays show that the ball was missing the leg stump, not by much though.
A lbw appeal against Sarfraz is given not out. Ramdin thinks otherwise and tell Holder to opt for the review. He obliges and takes the review.
FOUR! Sarfraz was struggling a bit and this will help him out a bit. Short, loose and on the body, right in his zone and that's a gift. He stays back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
A full ball fired in way outside off, Babar Azam reaches out to it and whacks it through cover-point for a single.
Angling into Azam, played with the angle towards mid-wicket for a single.
Pitched outside off, driven through covers for a single.

Short delivery outside off, Azam looks to pull but is way early into his shot. The ball catches the toe end of the bat and runs towards third man, Sarfraz is quick to take off and completes the single.

CONFUSION IN THE MIDDLE! Sarfraz shuffles across, Pollard sees that and angles it into his body, Sarfraz does well to play it with soft hands towards square leg and calls for two but is sent back by Azam. The fielder present there is quick on his toes and picks the ball up and throws at the bowler's end but fails to hit.
Full delivery outside off, driven to long on for a single.
Full outside off, Azam slices it over backward point for a couple. The slow outfield doesn't allow the ball to reach the fence.
Length delivery outside off, Azam cuts it through covers for a single. He will keep the strike.
Slower one outside off, tapped gently with soft hands towards the cover region for a quick single.
Angling into the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! CLOBBERED IT! Slower delivery and pitched on a length. Azam waits for it and then smashes it over mid-wicket for a maximum. Now that he has completed his century, he is now ready to free his arms.
Full delivery around off, slogged to mid-wicket for a single.
2nd ODI ton for Babar Azam!

BACK-TO-BACK CENTURIES! Full outside off, Azam covers his stumps and drives it through widish mid off for a single. With this he completes his century and gets down on the ground to thank the almighty.
Full on off, clipped straight to man at mid-wicket. Dot to end the over.
Length delivery outside off, Azam rolls his wrists to send the ball through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and angling in at 101 kmph, clipped through square leg to pick up a brace.
Length delivery, Ahmed charges down and flat-bats it to long on for a single.
A little quicker this time but straight on the pads, flicked to fine leg for a single.
109 kmph delivery on middle and off, driven with ease to long on for a single.
POLLARD returns.
Angling into the batsman, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full delivery, angling in, Ahmed charges down looking for a big slog but fails to connect and the ball sneaks through.
Angling into the pads, Azam shuffles across and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Ahmed drives the ball to long on for a single.
Pitched outside off, Ahmed looks to paddle but misses and gets hit on the body.
Length delivery, angling in from around off, pushed through mid on for a single.
Flatter one outside off, some width on offer as Babar Azam looks to cut this away. Gets a bottom edge which goes off the keeper's pads.
Full and flighted outside off, it's pushed to the left of the bowler.
Fourth single in a row. Nicely done. Sarfraz taps it with soft hands to the off side and calls for a quick run. Comfortably gets it in the end.
Looped up on off, drilled down to long off for another run.
Benn floats this one up on middle and off, Sarfraz dances down the track and whips it down to long on for a single.
Tossed up on off stump, from around the wicket, hit down to long on for one run.
Full on leg, Azam clears his front leg and drives to long on for a single.
Angling down leg, worked off the pads for a couple through square leg.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends.
Outside off, sliced to point.
Pitched on a length outside off, guided through to third man for a single.
Length delivery, angling in, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
CARLOS BRATHWAITE is back into the attack.
Shortish delivery outside off, turning away, cut to sweeper-cover off the back foot for a single.
Fuller on the stumps, clipped to mid-wicket for no run.
Served outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Tossed up around off, SA gets to the pitch of the ball and flicks through the gap in mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Sliding down leg with the arm, clipped towards fine leg for a single.

NOT OUT! Short and wide outside off, Ahmed looks to cut it but gets a bottom edge which almost gets dragged on. The bails are off and Ramdin appeals. The square leg umpire wants to have a look upstairs for a stumping chance. The replay shows that the ball first hits Narine's pads and then goes onto hit the stumps. Also, Ahmed's leg is firm in the crease and he is safe.
The umpires go upstairs to check whether Sarfraz is stumped or not.
Full outside off, pushed through cover-point again for a single.
Shortish delivery outside off, guided through cover-point for a single.
Served outside off, Ahmed kneels down to sweep but misses and gets hit on the body.
Shortish delivery, turning in from outside off, BA camps back and punches it through mid on for a single.
Full around off, Sarfraz stretches ahead and drives it on full for a single.
Turning away outside off, Ahmed rocks back and opens the face a bit to play at this. Punches this square of the wicket on the off side and gets it through the gap. A single is taken.
Three in a row. Well, this is a rare sight today. Benn shortens the length back a bit and keeps it on the stumps, Safraz Ahmed gets back punches it back to the bowler.
This time Sarfraz connects as he steps out to block this one. Two dot ball for Benn now.
Sarfraz Ahmed comes out to this fullish delivery to defend but ends up getting hit on the pads.
Loopy and shorter in length, outside off, it's punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.

FOUR! And he's welcomed with a boundary. Benn tosses it up around off, some nice loop on that, Babar Azam plants his front foot forward and drives it hard through the covers to send it across the boundary line. Superb shot.
SULIEMANN BENN is back on.
Shortish delivery outside off, cut through point for a single.
Sliding down leg, clipped through sqaure leg to get off the mark with a single.
SARFRAZ AHMED is the next man in to bat.
Drinks break!

OUT! MALIK DEPARTS! Shortish delivery outside off, the ball bounces a touch extra which surprises Malik, who gets back in his crease and cuts. However, the ball goes off the bottom part of the bat straight into the hands of Bravo at backward point. A brilliant knock comes to an end with this. Supporters are disappointed as Malik was giving them worth for their money and was just 10 short of completing his century. Narine with the breakthrough for his team!
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! STAND AND DELIVER! Tossed up outside off, Malik stretches his hands and lofts it on the bounce over mid off for yet another boundary. Malik is just tearing this Windies attack apart!
Wide! Sliding down leg with the angle, Malik looks to flick but gets off-balanced while playing the shot. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Served outside off, sliced through point for a single.
Full outside off, Azam gently pushes it through mid off for a single.
Length delivery outside off, cut to point.
Fuller delivery around middle and off, driven to long on for a single.
Angling into the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Again a full delivery outside leg, this time Malik manages to clip it past Narine at short fine leg but only picks up a single.
Slower delivery, pitched outside leg, Azam still goes after it and clips it through fine leg. Narine present there, dives to his left and keeps it down to one. Good, spirited effort by Narine!
KIERON POLLARD is brought on to bowl. Quite late in the innings here. Will be interesting to see if he can provide the breakthrough his side has been desperately needing for a good while now.
Pitched on middle and leg, driven past the bowler for a single.
FOUR! SLOGGED IT! Served fuller on middle and off, Azam gets down on one knee and slogs it one bounce into the fence through mid-wicket.
Served outside off, pushed to covers.
Full on the stumps, driven to long on for a single.
Wide outside off, cut through the gap in the point region for a single.
Short delivery outside off, cut to backward point where Holder fields and prevents Pakistan from running.
Pitched outside off, tapped to point.
Short delivery angling in, tucked through square leg for another brace.
Good variation by Holder. Fires in a full delivery on off, Malik does well to clip it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Malik pulls it through backward square leg for a couple.
Off-cutter outside off, spinning in after pitching, Azam does well to adjust and pushes it to long on for a single.
Length delivery outside off, taped to point.

Ah! That was a close call. Narine loops this one nicely around off, it turns in sharply as Malik looks to play at this. Gets an inside edge onto his pads and just falls besides him. Was lucky that didn't go on to disturb the bails.
Turning in on middle and off, some rare flight given by Sunil Narine, it's tucked through the square leg region for another run.
Fuller and flatter on the stumps, it's driven down to long on for a single.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. Two runs added to the total.
Slightly fuller once more on the stumps, it's turned to the on side making good use of the wrists. A single is taken.
Tossed up on middle and leg, turned behind square on the leg side for a simple run.
SUNIL NARINE is back on!
Full length delivery on leg stump, it's clipped down to fine leg for a run to end the over.
Holder keeps it on the shorter side and bowls in on the stumps, Azam uses the crease well, goes deep and whips it to mid-wicket for one run.
Good length ball outside off, Azam opens the face of the blade and dabs it to backward point. Dot ball.

FOUR! Takes the aerial route here. Full ball from Jason Holder, around the off stump, Babar Azam stands his ground and lofts this over covers inside out. Clears the infield with ease and sends it all the way to the fence.
On a good length and around off, Malik drops it in front of covers, to the left of the fielder there to be more precise and takes a quick single.
Full ball outside off, it's pushed to the covers off the front foot.
JASON HOLDER brings himself back on.
Missed out there. Babar Azam stepped out to this length delivery in an attempt to pull it away. Ends up miscuing it to the mid on fielder. He seems disappointed with himself.

Back of a length and outside off, plenty of width on offer here, it's slapped through the covers. The man out in the deep runs to his left, cuts it across just inside the ropes and restricts the batsmen to just a brace.
Length delivery on the stumps, it's punched down to mid on.
Short of a length deliverty angling in on leg, Shoaib swivels and pulls it down to fine leg for one more. The scoreboard keeps on ticking for the Men in Green.
On a good length and pitched outside off, Azam steers this down to third man with an angled bat. Will get a run to his name as he jogs over to the other end.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Shoaib Malik brings the wrists into the play and turns it through square leg for one.
Shoaib Malik walks down the track and smacks this full ball to wide long off for a single. 20 runs have come off this over. A big one for Pakistan.
Slight halt in the play as the ball goes on the road after being hit out of the ground by Shoaib Malik!

SIX! THREE IN A ROW! What has Shoaib Malik had for brunch here? He's come out today bang-bang! Benn tosses it up on middle and leg, drifting in, Malik makes a little room for himself and launches this really, really high. Sends it out of the park, over the mid-wicket boundary for half a dozen. Monstrous!
SIX! TWO IN TWO! He's on fire here. Malik steps out to this one and murders this back down the ground. Clears the long on boundary for a biggie. That's a big hit.
SIX! THAT'S A TOWERING BLOW! That was almost as big as Suliemann Benn. Tossed up on middle and off, Shoaib Malik dances down the wicket and smokes this back down the ground for a maximum.
Full and loopy on middle stump, defended off the front foot and into the track.
Tosses this up nicely outside off, Babar Azam plants his front foot forward and drills it through to wide long off for a single.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Shoaib Malik defends this in front of covers.
Rising a bit on the batsman, he does well though to stay on top and slap it through extra cover for one run.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Malik hops to play at it. Taps it with soft hands in front of covers and scurries to the other end to complete a run.

Wide! Jospeh comes steaming in and hits the deck hard. Bangs this one in short but the line isn't right. It's going down the leg side as Shoaib Malik looks to pull this away. Misses and a wide is called by the umpire.
Back of a length delivery on the body, Babar stays deep within his crease and pulls it through to deep mid-wicket for a comfortable single.
Angling in on the pads once more, Malik turns it through square leg this time and picks up a single for doing so.
Length delivery straying on the pads, Babar Azam adjusts his body a bit and punches it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
ALZARRI JOSEPH is back on.
Darted in on middle and leg, drifting in, it's worked comfortably to the on side for no run. That'll be the end of the over.
38th ODI fifty for Shoaib Malik!

FOUR! What a shot to get to your half century! Malik makes good use of his feet, gets to the pitch of the delivery and drills it straight back down the ground. No stopping that as the ball races away to the boundary line.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Babar Azam hits this just wide of the cover fielder and down through to long off for one turn.
Benn with a lovely tossed up ball and attacking the stumps, Azam presses forward and keeps it out solidly.
Flighted on leg stump and turning away from the batsman, Babar Azam uppishly pushes this towards point. He is slightly done in by the turn there.
6th ODI fity for Babar Azam!
Tossed up nicely by Kraigg Brathwaite, Babar Azam drills this to wide long off for a single. Brings up his fifty with that and it's been a superb knock so far.
This full ball is hit down to long on for one.
Too easy for Pakistan here, this time Babar Azam drills it through the cover region for a single.
Knocking it around and rotating the strike, sensible stuff from the Pakistan batsmen here. It's hit down to long on this time for one run.
Floats this one up outside off, the batsman leans into this one and simply pushes it down towards the long off fielder for one.
Short and flat outside off, Azam rocks back and punches it through to sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
It's eased back down to long off for a single. End of the over. The runs are still leaking for the West Indies.
Superb technique and great footwork as well. Babar Azam steps out to this fullish loopy ball and offers a straight bat in defense. Solid.
Another looped up delivery from the left-armer, coming from around the wicket, blocked.
Floated by Benn around off, Babar comes forward and keeps it out with a straight bat.

FOUR! Classy, pretty and beautifully done. Risk free batting and that's so good to see. Tossed up delivery outside off, Babar Azam leans into the drive and creams it through the gap in the covers for a boundary. Didn't look like he put any effort into playing that, did it with so much ease.
Benn tosses it up on the pads, Shoaib Malik plays with the turn and works it to square leg for a single.
Short and outside off, cut away for no run.
FOUR! That's put away! Full and loopy well outside off, Babar Azam gets down to this one and drills it through the covers for a boundary.
Looped up and pitched outside off, it's hit down to long off for a single.
Loopy and shortish outside, it's cut down towards short third man.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Fuller ball outside off, nicely flighted by Brathwaite, it's driven through covers for a couple of runs.
Full on middle and leg, Malik drives it to wide mid on.
On the pads, Malik tries to play it across but misses and gets hit on the pads. The umpire turns down the appeal.
Full on middle and off, flicked away to the leg side.
On middle and off, Malik defends it into the ground.
SIX! What a shot! On middle and off, Malik comes down the track and smashes it over the long on region. The ball clears the rope and Malik gets a biggie under his name.
Tossed up on middle and off, Malik drives it back to the bowler.
Full around off, Malik drives it through m id on for a single to end the over.
Shortish outside off, Malik tries to cut but misses it completely.
Landed outside off, Malik plays it to the point region.
Shortish outside off, Azam cuts it through point for a single.
Around off, Malik drives it through mid on and takes a single.
Around off, Malik drives it back to the bowler.
KRAIGG BRATHWAITE comes on to bowl.
On middle and off, Malik comes down the track and drills it to long on for a single.
Around off, Malik covers the line and defends.
Driven to mid off by Malik.

Terrific delivery! Malik never picked the length up there. That one spun, bounced and beat the batsman. Loopy and turning away from the batsman, around off, Shoaib Malik tries to stay back and keep it out off the back foot. Benn goes up in an appeal for a caught behind but the umpire isn't interested.

SIX! BIG HIT! That was there to be punished and that's exactly what Shoaib Malik has done. He steps out to this one and takes it on the full. Had a lot of flight there as he smacked this back down the ground for a maximum. Terrific shot!
Benn comes from around the wicket, tosses it up on middle and off, it's driven down to long off for one run.
SULIEMAN BENN comes on to bowl.
Floats this one up on off stump, Babar Azam drives this down to long off for a single to end the over.
Turning in on middle and off, on the shorter side this time, it's played with the spin and turned to the on side. Dot ball.
Full and on the stumps, it's eased back past the bowler for an easy run.
Sunil gives this some decent air, tosses it up there and draws Malik forward to block.
Short and flat just around off, Shoaib Malik rocks back and punches it to the left of Narine.
Narine tosses it up around off, Babar Azam dances down the track and pushes it down to long off for a single.
Length delivery, wide outside off, cut through backward point. The fielder at point dives to make a stop but fails to do so and the batsmen run through for a single.
Angling into the pads, driven through mid on for a single.
Full around off, driven to long on for a single.
50-run stand between Azam and Malik!
FOUR! Back of a length delivery, doesn't bounce much, Azam waits for it and then pulls it hard through the gap between mid on and mid-wicket for a boundary.
Pitched outside off, Azam looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Length delivery outside off, pushed to covers.
Drinks break!
Looped up on middle and off, eased down to long on for a comfortable run.
Narine gives this some decent flight, tosses it up there. Babar comes ahead to work it to the on side but gets an inside edge onto his pads. That saves him from the lbw appeal.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Babar Azam crisply drives this straight to the man at covers.
Attacking the stumps once more, it's whipped to mid-wicket for nothing.
Flatter and shorter on middle and off, turning in, it's hit back to the bowler.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Angling in on middle and leg, driven to long on for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Azam pulls it from outside off for a single towards deep mid-wicket.
Angling down leg, tucked on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! CHARGED DOWN! Length delivery outside off, Malik charges down and flat-bats it over the mid on fielder for a boundary. Malik not letting Brathwite settle in the middle.
Full and angling in, Malik flicks it towards the square leg boundary and sets himself for a couple and does it so easliy.

DRAMA IN THE MIDDLE! Length delivery around off, angling in, Azam pulls it over mid-wicket. As he plays the shot, he expects it to reach the boundary but the slow outfield prevents it from doing so. Malik who charges in from the other end, wants a couple but is sent back in bis crease. The throw is at his end but he does well to reach back in. Danger avoided! Only a single taken!
Pitched wide outside off, Azam waits for it and cuts it through point for a single.
Full around off, gently driven to long on for a single.
Flatter one outside off, cut to backward point.
Served outside off, Malik gets low in his crease and guides it past first slip for a couple.
Spinning in from outside off, defended towards covers.
Flatter on middle and leg, worked off the front foot for a single through mid-wicket.

SIX! WHAT A SHOT! Shoaib Malik being fearless here. Comes down the track to this fuller length delivery and smokes this perfectly. Gets it right off the middle of the bat and clears the long on fence with ease.
Full ball and attacking the stumps, Shoaib Malik drives this to the mid on fielder for nothing.
Short and outside off, it's cut to backward point for a single. Nicely done.
Drags the length back a bit and pitches it on a length this time, Azam whips this towards mid-wicket as the ball falls short of the mid-wicket fielder.
Fuller in length once more and homing in on middle and off, Babar Azam works this in front of mid-wicket.
Fullish in length and coming in around off, it's driven straight back to Carlos Brathwaite.
Malik opens the face of the bat to this at the last second and works it to first slip. End of the over.
Short and wide outside off, punched off the back foot to point for nothing.
Narine bowls it right up there, still maintains a flatter trajectory, Azam plants his front foot across and turns it with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter in length and pitched around off, turning in, Shoaib Malik goes back to this one and whips it down to long on for a run.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Babar Azam clears his front leg and drives it down to long on for one.
Starts off with a full and flat ball on the stumps, it's flicked through the mid-wicket region for a single.
SUNIL NARINE is brought into the attack now.
Pitched outside off, Azam looks to loft it over the infield but mistimes it towards mid off fielder, who collects it on one bounce.
Full outside off, Malik goes for a wild slog but gets an inside edge towards the square leg boundary for a single.
Full on the pads, clipped straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Full outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Outside off, BA leans ahead and taps it towards point.

FOUR! FIELDER FAILS TO SPOT THE BALL! Angling into the pads, AA shuffles across a touch and flicks it through backward square leg. The man at deep square leg runs on the wrong side and the ball races to the fence.
CARLOS BRATHWAITE comes into the bowling attack.
Powerplay 2 has been taken. 4 fielders will now be allowed outside the 30-yard circle.

THAT WAS CASUAL FROM AZAM! Length delivery angling down leg, Azam stays in his crease and pulls it over fine leg but doesn't time it well and the ball falls just short of the man in the deep. One run is taken.
Back of a length delivery around off, Malik stays within the crease and defends it with soft hands towards mid on for a quick single. Good running!
Length delivery, Azam works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Angling in from around off, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Angling into the batsman, Azam looks to flick but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Angling down leg, clipped through to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, nipping a touch back in, Azam looks to cut it off the back foot but fails to connect as the ball keeps a touch low.
Full on middle and off, driven through mid on. Carlos Brathwaite slides to his left and makes a good stop, giving away no run.
Azam gets carried away! Pitched wide outside off, Azam goes for an expansive drive but gets beaten as the ball stays a touch low.
FOUR! NICELY DONE! Back of a length delivery, Azam sees it early and crisply cuts it by riding the bounce through point for a boundary.
Length delivery, angling in, Malik shuffles again and looks to work it through the gap at square leg but finds the fielder stationed there.
Full and angling in, driven to mid on.
Pitched outside off, Malik prods forward and defends solidly to cover-point.
Back of a length delivery outside off, SM shuffles across a touch and then hops and defends it to mid on.
Length delivery outside off, Azam waits for the ball to come near him and then gently guides it through to third man for a single.
Length delivery, angling into the pads, flicked through forward square leg for a single.
On a good length and just around the off stump, Babar Azam bring his bat ahead and keeps it tight alongside his pads. Defends it down into the track to end the over. Maiden from the Windies skipper.
Full and aiming the base of off stump, Azam prods forward and off the inside half of the bat, drives it down to mid on. Another dot ball.
Tad fuller than the previous delivery, it's flicked to the mid-wicket region for no run.
Holder's banging the deck hard here. Comes charging in, makes good use of his height and angles in a length ball to the batsman, it's solidly kept out with a front foot punch to mid on.
Length ball outside off, Babar Azam opens the face and dabs to the man at point. Won't get any run for it.

Ripper to start off with. Length delivery in the channel outside off, it's tailing in heavily as Babar Azam looks to punch it away off his back foot. It beats the inside edge and goes into the keeper's gloves. Just missed the off pole, there. Good delivery.
Angling into the body of the batsman, played with the angle for a single through mid-wicket.
Pitched outside off, pushed to covers.
Malik opens the face of his bat and guides the outside off delivery through to third man to get off the mark with a single.
Full and angling in, driven to mid on.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball.
Wide! Back of a length delivery, angling down leg, Malik leaves it by hoping a touch inwards. The umpire spreads his arms, signalling it as a wide.
SHOAIB MALIK walks in at No.4.

OUT! ALZARRI JOSEPH WITH HIS MAIDEN ODI WICKET! Length delivery outside off, angling away, Sharjeel slogs at it looking to clear Holder, who is 6ft 8 and fielding at mid on. He takes a couple of steps to his left and takes the catch with a reverse cup. WI are coming back strongly over here after leaking runs in the start. Alzarri Joseph gets his rewards for bowling consistently at good lines and lengths. The dangerous Sharjeel has to depart after scoringa quick-fire 24!
On a length and outside off, played to point for no run.
BABAR AZAM is the new man in.

OUT! HE'S GONE! A review wasted, really. Even to the naked eye he was caught plumb. Holder comes charging in and sharply angles in a length ball around off, Azhar Ali shuffles across a bit to play at this but fails to connect and is rapped on the pads. Loud appeals for an lbw and the umpire raises his finger. Azhar Ali walks down and talks to Sharjeel as he thinks he might not be out. He decides to take a review and the decision goes upstairs. Replays show that he is rapped dead in front of the stumps and he is gone. The Pakistan skipper has to make the long walk back. Early breakthrough for Pakistan.
Azhar Ali is caught leg before and given out. He isn't convinced though and after talking to his partner, decides to take a review against the decision.
On middle and off, it's worked towards mid-wicket for a brisk single.

FOUR! You bowl it too short and he will punish you. Back of a length and on the body, too, too straight and Sharjeel puts it away. Swivels across and pulls it across the fine leg fence for a boundary.
On a good length once more and angling away from Sharjeel, it's worked towards backward point. Can't get it past the man there, though.
Holder with a cutter outside off, pitches it on a length, Azhar Ali stays back to this one and plays it very late. Guides it down to third man for an easy single.
Angling into the pads, glanced to fine leg for a single.
Length delivery, Sharjeel timely flicks it through squiare leg but deep square leg is present there, which keeps it down to one.
Back of a length delivery, tucked through the leg side for a single.

The batsman rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball through backward point, the point fielder runs across and cuts it off and hurls a direct hit. Ali thinks of taking a run off the deflection but eventually decides against it.
Length delivery, angling across, Sharjeel uses his wrists and flicks this from outside off, towards mid-wicket for a single.
Leg bye! Angling into Ali, he looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The ball goes to the leg side, fetching them one leg bye.
SIX! INTENT IS CRYSTAL CLEAR FROM PAK! Full outside off, Khan lofts it over mid off. Timing is superb on that one and the ball sails into the stands. 22 runs off the over!
FOUR! SLOGGED IT! Full outside off, Sharjeel slogs it, doesn't time it well but well enough to clear the infield and run to the mid-wicket fence.
Full and width on offer. Sharjeel doesn't let these go through. He swings his bat hard and ends up slicing it over point for a couple.
Full and angling into the batsman, clipped through mid-wicket for three runs.
Length delivery, angling away, Khan flicks it wristily for a single through mid-wicket.
Angling into the pads, Ali looks to defend off the front foot but gets an inside edge onto the pads and towards the square leg region. The batsmen run through for a single.

Five Wides! Full and angling down leg, AA looks to flick for some easy pickings but fails to connect. Ramdin behind the stumps also can't get to it and the ball runs away to the fence. Five wides signalled by the umpire.

FOUR! FIRST BOUNDARY OF THE MATCH! Length delivery angling away, Sharjeel pokes at it and the ball goes through to the third man fence off the outside edge of his bat. It was a good delivery by the youngster.
Full delivery just outside off, pushed gently down the ground for no runs.
Angling into the pads, clipped to fine leg for a single.
Full outside off, mistimely driven to covers.
Pitched outside off, tapped to mid off.
Wide! That's a wayward delivery, angling down leg, left alone. The umpire signnals it as wide. Joseph losing the control on the swing.
Good line and length first up. Pitching it on a length outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
ALZARRI JOSEPH, the debutant to bowl from the other end.
Full and angling down leg, flicked to fine leg for a single. First runs of the match!
Outside off, left alone.
Length delivery outside off, defended from within the crease.

Length delivery outside off, Azhar pushes through point and takes off for a single but is sent back by his partner. It could have been an easy single if taken. Poor call by Sharjeel Khan to send the skipper back.
Angling in from outside off, Ali delas with it carefully by presenting a front foot defense.
Full outside off, Ali reaches for it and drives to covers.
Players are out in the middle. JASON HOLDER is setting the field for himself as he will bowl first up. SHARJEEL KHAN and AZHAR ALI will open for the home side.

JASON HOLDER says it was tough in the first game and they just have to cope with it. Also says that they have to start well and capitalize on that. Stresses on the fact that you have to have that positive intent and look to push the ball positively against the spinners. Adds that each and every individual has to do their part, especially in the middle order. Mentions there is one forced change, Shannon Gabriel is out with a sore neck and Alzarri Joseph comes in his place.

AZHAR ALI says they will bat first. States that the surface is quite good and there are runs to be scored if the batsmen apply themselves. Adds that the runs on the board and the uneven nature makes it difficult to bat later on. Opines that every time he goes out there he tries to play without any pressure. Says that he wants his side to enjoy the game and execute their plans to perfection. Mentions they are playing with the Same team.
PAKISTAN WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BAT FIRST!

Pitch Report - It will be difficult to field in this immense heat. The pitch hasn't opened up despite some cracks being there. It will play like the first game, slow and will turn. The team batting first has won 59 percent of the games. So, the strategy will be to win the toss and put runs on the board, reckons Bazid Khan.

Hello and a warm welcome to everyone for the 2nd ODI between Pakistan and West Indies at Sharjah. Pakistan have taken the lead in this series and will look to seal the series with a win today. The men from the Caribbean are yet to register a win in the Gulf. This is their chance to do so and reinstate the lost confidence by picking up their first win in this tour. Let's hope we witness an enthralling contest between bat and ball. Stay tuned as we bring you the toss and the team news.
